shots.caption: feed cover up
shots.pre: await R.target('weapon:m240'); const at=n=>{let a;T.scene.traverse(o=>{if(o.name===n&&o.getWorldPosition(new T.THREE.Vector3()).y>20)a=o});return a}; const c=at('m240-feed-cover'); if(!c) throw Error('feed cover missing'); c.rotation.x=1.05;

shots.caption: barrel handle right, charger back
shots.pre: await R.target('weapon:m240'); const at=n=>{let a;T.scene.traverse(o=>{if(o.name===n&&o.getWorldPosition(new T.THREE.Vector3()).y>20)a=o});return a}; const c=at('m240-feed-cover'), h=at('m240-barrel-handle'), q=at('m240-charging-handle'); if(!c||!h||!q) throw Error('M240 part missing'); c.rotation.x=0; h.rotation.z=-1.1; q.position.z=-0.13;
